name: CSO_ARTICLE_STATS
description: This table will be populated hourly and daily from cso_stg_article_view. In the future we plan to add counts from ratings and recommendations. Hourly rollup will be deleted at the end of every day once the day ends. At the end of every month, older daily rollup data will be purged.

columns.name: ARTICLE_STATS_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. Populated by sequence number.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID for the interface. Will be used to identify an HR view from a Service view.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: A way to uniquely identify an article by locale ID and content ID.

columns.name: ARTICLE_VIEW_COUNT
columns.description: The article view count based on answer ID.

columns.name: CASELINK_COUNT
columns.description: The number of caselinks based on answer ID.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_COUNT
columns.description: The number of articles published based on answer ID.

columns.name: RATING_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count based on answer ID.

columns.name: RATING_01_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count with a value of one based on answer ID.

columns.name: RATING_02_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count with a value of two based on answer ID.

columns.name: RATING_03_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count with a value of three based on answer ID.

columns.name: RATING_04_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count with a value of four based on answer ID.

columns.name: RATING_05_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count with a value of five based on answer ID.

columns.name: THUMBS_UP_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count with a value of thumbs up based on answer ID.

columns.name: THUMBS_DOWN_COUNT
columns.description: The article rating count with a value of thumbs down based on answer ID.

columns.name: RATING_SUM
columns.description: The article rating sum based on answer ID.

columns.name: VERSION_COUNT
columns.description: The number of versions based on answer ID.

columns.name: STAT_DATE
columns.description: The date the stats occurred in DDMMYYYY format.

columns.name: STAT_HOUR
columns.description: Applicable for window=1 and represents the HOUR of the DAY for which the data belongs to.

columns.name: WINDOW
columns.description: 1-hourly, 2-daily, 3-monthly (rollup strategy).
